strategy.name: qqq_stochrsi_position_gate_comparison
strategy.description: Compare three frozen QQQ mother strategies and nine all-in-or-cash timing accounts derived from each mother's completed post-trade QQQ weight. Mother M1 is D0_F0_S0 from TIM-v0.80a.2. Mother M2 is D0_F1_S1, which adds the sparse StochRSI42 recovery and StochRSI100 recovery buys to the original accumulation and pool-sale state machine. Mother M4 is a separate four-state target-weight process: StochRSI42 turns its short state on at a strict upcross above 0.20 and off at a strict downcross below 0.10; StochRSI100 does the same for its long state; the daily target QQQ weights for neither/short-only/long-only/both states are 0%/40%/60%/100%. For each mother, three independent fixed-capital accounts hold 100% QQQ only when the mother's same-Close post-trade QQQ weight is strictly greater than 70%, 80%, or 90%, otherwise 100% cash.
strategy.buy_rule: M1 and M2 preserve their frozen B2-over-B1 accumulation rules and M2 additionally preserves its two low-position recovery buys. M4 rebalances to 40% when only the StochRSI42 state is on, 60% when only the StochRSI100 state is on, and 100% when both are on. Each derived gate buys all-in QQQ when its source mother's completed post-trade QQQ weight becomes strictly greater than its own 70%, 80%, or 90% threshold.
strategy.sell_rule: M1 and M2 preserve the frozen Pool A and Pool B sell mechanisms, including the theoretical StochRSI100=0.30 fast-drop special case. M4 rebalances down to 60%, 40%, or 0% as its two component states turn off below 0.10. Each derived gate sells all QQQ whenever its source mother's completed post-trade weight is not strictly greater than the gate threshold; equality is cash.
strategy.signal_time: All StochRSI crossings and mother post-trade QQQ weights use completed current adjusted-Close data. M4 state history is causally warmed on approved observations before 2015-01-02. A gate reads the deterministic completed post-trade weight produced by its mother on the same Close.
strategy.execution_time: All ordinary mother rebalances and all gate entries/exits execute at the same adjusted Close that confirms the signal, with zero transaction cost. M1/M2 retain the frozen fast-drop theoretical-price exception. Gate orders always use the ordinary adjusted Close and never inherit that theoretical fill price.
strategy.positioning: Long-only fractional QQQ and cash. Every account starts with $100,000. M1 and M2 may add external cash only under their frozen minimum-buy rules, and each is compared with its own contribution-matched Buy & Hold. M4 and all nine gate accounts never accept external cash. Gate accounts do not copy mother cash flows or mother position size; they only copy the binary weight signal.

plain_language.summary: 比较三种QQQ仓位管理方法，并检验它们的持仓比例能否直接变成全仓或空仓的择时信号。
plain_language.buy: 三条母策略按各自规则增加QQQ；九条独立择时账户只在对应母策略的QQQ仓位严格高于70%、80%或90%时全仓买入。
plain_language.sell: 母策略按各自规则减仓；择时账户一旦不再严格高于门槛，就把QQQ全部卖出并持有现金。
plain_language.execution: 当天收盘确认信号并按当天收盘成交，门槛相等时视为空仓。
plain_language.position: 每个账户从10万美元开始；九条择时账户和四状态母策略不追加本金，两个复杂母策略的追加本金只进入各自的同步注资基准。

parameters.gate_signal_source: mother post-trade QQQ market value divided by mother equity on the same Close
parameters.gate_capital_policy: independent fixed $100,000 initial capital; no external contributions
parameters.final_comparison_paths: nine position gates plus naive QQQ Buy & Hold
parameters.performance_return_method_with_flows: daily time-weighted returns; XIRR also reported

financing: No leverage or borrowing. Only M1/M2 frozen minimum-buy shortfalls can add external cash; M4 and all gates cannot.
benchmark: M1 and M2 each have a contribution-matched QQQ Buy & Hold plus naive QQQ Buy & Hold. M4 and all nine fixed-capital gates compare directly with naive QQQ Buy & Hold.

reporting.reuse_review: Reuse v5 unchanged. Add mother-group equity and capital panels plus one directly comparable ten-line gate-versus-QQQ chart.

research.hypothesis: A complex continuous position process may be more useful as a trend-membership signal than as a standalone single-asset capital-allocation strategy, and fixed 70/80/90 gates reveal how much information survives binary conversion.
research.primary_metric: For the nine fixed-capital gates: CAGR, Sharpe, maximum drawdown and average exposure versus naive QQQ. For M1/M2: cash-flow-adjusted CAGR, Sharpe, drawdown and XIRR versus contribution-matched Buy & Hold.
research.selection_rule: Report all 12 predeclared strategy paths without selecting a winner. The nine gate paths are the only common-capital final comparison; identical paths remain visible and are diagnosed rather than deduplicated.
research.validation_plan: Reconcile every mother and gate order, daily cash, shares, equity and FIFO trade against compiled PyBroker replay; verify strict gate equality, no gate contributions, causal state warmup, four-state targets and the expected equivalence of M4's 70/80/90 gates.
research.promotion_criteria: A gate is a rotation-signal candidate only if its return/drawdown tradeoff is useful versus naive QQQ and its behavior is not dependent on external contributions or threshold equality accidents.
research.rejection_conditions: Reject any path if reconciliation fails, a gate receives external cash, a gate uses a pre-trade rather than post-trade mother weight, equality enters QQQ, or four-state weights do not match the frozen target map.
